title: Decentralised Brands
description: Distinguish participation from authority, then examine bounded custody, selective cooperation and survivable exit.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Decentralised Brands asks how autonomous organizations could share a promise without surrendering their future.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Distinguish participation from authority, then examine bounded custody, selective cooperation and survivable exit.
readerOutcomes: The distinction is between useful coordination and an unlimited right to control the common future.
Exit, succession, and resistance to capture therefore matter alongside interoperability.
Read it to examine whether a shared promise can outlive the private power of its custodian.
